newsitem.title: USA: TNP revises year, Q4 results for settlement.
newsitem.headline: TNP revises year, Q4 results for settlement.

text.p: TNP Enterprises Inc said Friday it has revised down its earnings to $22.9 million, or $1.98 per share for the year, and to $328,000, or $0.03 per share for the fourth quarter.
TNP previously announced earnings of $24.2 million, or $2.10 per share, for the year ended December 31, 1996, and $1.6 million, or $0.12 per share, for the quarter.

The company said the earnings were revised to include a reserve for the recent tentative settlement of litigation related to the early redemption of $29.2 million of Series T first mortgage bonds in 1995.
TNP called and redeemed the bonds at par with proceeds from the sale of its Panhandle properties. The other parties to the litigation were contesting TNP's right to call the bonds.
The proposed settlement, which is subject to approval by a federal judge, calls for TNP to pay $2 million to the parties of the lawsuit.
